name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta Province of northwest Argentina. Diablillos hosts one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally, with Measured & Indicated resources of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.54 million ounces of gold. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in June 2026 and is working toward a construction decision, backed by strategic investors including Kinross Gold and Eric Sprott.
